# `nlink-lab node add`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Add a namespace node (link it with `link add`)

Usage: nlink-lab node add [OPTIONS] <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>
          The node's name

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --profile <PROFILE>
          A profile of the topology for it

      --dry-run
          Show the plan; change nothing

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
